meaning: asserted means an explicit oracle exists, not necessarily that it passes; see run reports for results

behaviors.assertion: Greeting, exact active counts/weights, empty maps after graceful close, RST, early disconnect, overlapping churn, and fresh IDs after reconnect.
Idle connection and allocated unanswered job remain open at least 85 seconds and close within 100 seconds, releasing state.

Independent SHA-1 solver; feedback/recovery; LF/CRLF/legacy and coalesced/fragmented frames; 1023/1024/1025 byte boundaries; empty/invalid UTF-8; initial field limits and nonce overflow. Arbitrarily delayed fragments are not specified by the legacy idle-framing protocol.
Intervals 1/2/5, rejected shares across publication boundaries, per-share reward sum, partial disconnect/shutdown and warmup. Reporting frequency must not discard earned work.

Independent formula vectors across all four threshold branches, distinct decay/divisor constants and fractional workers; independent reward-curve evaluation of actual mining inputs; forced blocks and hash chain.
Curve difficulty rounding and minimum vectors (internal); initial difficulty 100, curve difficulty from the last hashrate and the exponential hashrate average.
Zero/negative/nonfinite rejection without a difficulty change, valid recovery and missing/malformed estimation.
Name/IoT sanitization, defaults, 48-byte IoT and 96-byte key limits, legacy keys (blanked on `/data`, base64 in the sync upload), dashboard field types and numeric values.

PC/ESP weights, worker-limit rejection/recovery, ESP32 downgrade above mcu_pc_step_h, both cross-type recycling directions, user isolation, and 16000 seeded operations against an independent ordered-map model.
Multipart fields/metadata, failure retention, success subtraction, concurrent new-user work, cleanup failures, transport disconnect/timeouts, staging writes, retry and total preservation.
Startup failure without IP, cached-IP sync fallback, failed initial sync with no cache followed by valid retry.

Default creation, field defaults, generated key shape/uniqueness, roundtrip, malformed/missing fields, guessed port persisted and used for login, disabled dashboard and 20/21-byte authentication boundary.
An invalid reward curve body fails within a deadline with a matching diagnostic; master rejection/disconnect/invalid UTF-8 fail and bounded delayed greeting succeeds.
Persist/load/corrupt-file fallback, pre-existing and newly saved IP bans, localhost exemption, direct production curve refresh updates ban enforcement.

Final sync, logout and miner disconnect; a held upload finishes before the final snapshot, which conserves pending work. Remote exactly-once delivery after ambiguous acknowledgement is not guaranteed.
Configured limit rejects excess shares and first valid share after real 61-second expiry is accepted.
Refresh operation is directly invoked in the disposable copy; the real one-hour scheduler wait is not exercised.
Accept failures, write-side 90-second backpressure, file-descriptor exhaustion, clock rollback and kernel/process crashes are not deterministically injected.
Malformed JSON/missing fields are covered; zero/overflow difficulty, reward divisor, sync/stats intervals and every nonsensical numeric combination are not fully classified.
Authentication and schema are asserted; every HTTP method, encoded query variant and route rejection combination is not enumerated.
Updater/restart helpers, real firewall effects, ngrok, unreachable AVR binary-nonce mode and bench/dummy_sync configurations are outside this runtime audit.
Sustained load, memory/resource performance, and Linux/macOS execution are not established by Windows functional results.
